plainText:
Mable (Japanese: モミジ Momiji) is a recurring character found in and their sequel, . In X and Y, she is one of Team Flare's five . She is the only one of the five to reappear in Legends: Z-A, where she is the acting director of the in Lumiose City, conducting research on the Pokémon found in the wild zones of Lumiose City and their growing numbers. 

In X and Y, she is noted to be investigating different types of energy, with Legends: Z-A making it clear that she was specifically researching Pokémon life energy. 

==In the core series games==

=== Pokémon X and Y ===
Mable is one of five Team Flare scientists that are the driving force behind the team, being distinguishable with her blue hair, blue lipstick, and her prominent visor. She is first seen in the Frost Cavern agitating an with two s. With Trevor helping the in defeating the Grunts, the player then defeats Mable and forces her to retreat.

She is met again at Lysandre Labs, preparing for Team Flare's plan to use the ultimate weapon. Upon being defeated again, she hands the player the Elevator Key required to access the lower floors of the facility.

=== Pokémon Legends: Z-A ===
 

By helping complete her research requests, the player can earn TMs and other rewards.

====Base game====
After the events of Pokémon X and Y, Mable was taken into custody along with the rest of Team Flare. However, she was offered a plea deal and appointed as the acting director of the so the government can keep a close eye on her, effectively replacing Professor Sycamore following his resignation as the previous director some time before the events of Legends: Z-A. Mable also mentions that she is not allowed to leave Lumiose City or travel freely within it. Her dialogue while giving the player their Kanto First Partner Pokémon also implies she was given some instruction by Professor Sycamore. At the start of the game, due to the sudden increase in Pokémon since the beginning of the urban redevelopment plan, she is researching the habits of these new Pokémon and the reason for their sudden surge in population. She seeks the 's help in her investigation to offset her large workload by filling in the Lumiose Pokédex and Mega Evolution Pokédex.

Mable makes an important role later in the game. In attempts to uncover who Gris is so that the can battle him in the Z-A Royale, they make their way to Mable's office after hearing connections to Team Flare. Mable reaffirms the suspicions, Gris, whose real name is Grisham was a former member of Team Flare, raised as a part of a "new generation" for the organization. She initially tries to deflect the question, but at the players insistence she eventually provides information on the man, leading Team MZ to the Team Flare Nouveau truck at Centrico Plaza.

In the post game, Mable also provides a supporting role. Upon completing Mission 38: "The Future of Lumiose City" and returning to Hotel Z, the player learns about "the one who gives" and "the one who takes" from L, the former head of Team Flare. To gather some clues, they pay a visit to Mable, who is yelling about the occurrence of more wild zones. Upon asking, Mable provides information on Lysandre's previous goals with Team Flare. A Pokémon who gives life: and a Pokémon who takes it: . Upon heavy research, the intense amounts of Mega Power has caused wild Pokémon to travel closer and closer to Lumiose City, including the Legendary Pokémon of Kalos. After being tasked to take down three alpha Pokémon in the various Wild Zones, she tasks the player in stopping the two legendary Pokémon by catching them, as they could pose a threat to the people living in the city. As the player takes on these missions, Mable provides historical context with Xerneas and Yveltal and Team Flare, claiming that they had taken out numerous of their own Grunts. She then thanks the player for their help in calming Xerneas, stating that at least now it felt like all her research for Team Flare hadn't been for nothing.

====Mega Dimension====
Like many of the characters, Mable reappears during the events of the Mega Dimension DLC. Her first appearance is after Team MZ makes it out of Hyperspace Lumiose for the first time, appearing via Holo Caster excited about the discoveries in Lumiose. She then provides the with new research tasks and a new Pokédex, the Hyperspace Pokédex. This extra research may go into base game rewards.

While the player may visit her during the main story of the DLC, she only makes a few minimal appearances, notably getting transported to hyperspace along with the rest of the cast, whereupon she comments on how she would prefer not to lose her own life when sent into hyperspace despite her curiosity towards it. She eventually takes a larger role in the DLC's post game, assisting Corbeau and the Rust Syndicate in research of hyperspace once the player has defeated both and , explaining how 's nightmare-related powers mixed with the Mega Power leaking from the remains of Ange, resulting in the existence of Hyperspace Lumiose. Mable further explains that this resulted in a manifestations created by a subconscious of dreams and wishes, having both Pokémon and appear from within. Corbeau dismissively thanks Mable for her explanation, asking her what Ansha could do to summon . Mable proceeds with an overtly scientific answer that Ansha would have to "wish really hard". After a squabble she disappears from the room, with hopes that Ansha may succeed.

====Side missions====
Mable appears in three : Side Mission 22: "A Call from Mable", Side Mission EX2: "Project M", and Side Mission 194: "Volcanion Unleashed!".

In "A Call from Mable", Mable will request for the player to come to her office at the Research Lab. Upon entry, she will aggressively yell at her computer about the existence of Wild Zones, like she has prior. On behalf of the previous director, she then asks of the player to make a choice between three Pokémon; , or , just like Professor Sycamore had during the events of X and Y.

In "Project M", the player will reach down into the basement of Lysandre Labs holding both Mewtwonite X and Mewtwonite Y stones, awakening . This alerts Mable, forgetting that Mewtwo was found there in the first place, and that Mewtwo must be caught at all costs. Upon success, Mable appears using her Holo Caster. The five Team Flare scientists were originally tasked in catching Mewtwo, the same one found in the . As it had the capabilities to Mega Evolve, they had hoped that it could be used in case their plans with either and have gone awry. Mewtwo was eventually forgotten about, and was not needed, being left in the Lysandre Labs.

In "Volcanion Unleashed", Mable will request the player's help with a hacked Poké Ball containing the Mythical Pokémon , admitting Team Flare previously researched Poké Ball hacking and that she found it distasteful, then stating that she had to use drastic measures to free Volcanion that have almost certainly angered it. She then calls in Yvon from the Lumiose Press, who had used her sources to do some research on Volcanion. After the player calms and catches Volcanion, she will again thank them and admit she somewhat sympathizes with the Pokémon, as they both lost their freedom as a result of Team Flare's misdeeds.

===Pokémon the Series===
====History====
In the past, Mable, alongside Lysandre and the other Team Flare Scientists, would help those in need, until Lysandre became disillusioned with the human race and sought to restart the world.

Mable debuted in From A to Z!. She was first seen leading a group of s in Terminus Cave, where they attempted to capture . However, all of their Pokémon's combined attacks didn't even phase the Legendary Pokémon, which used on the villainous team members before disappearing. Mable was later seen informing Lysandre and Xerosic of the failure of her mission.

Mable briefly appeared in Meeting at Terminus Cave! in a video call with Xerosic, where she and Aliana were ordered to head to Z2 after Team Flare discovered its location thanks to their sensors.
 
In An Explosive Operation!, she, Aliana, and several Team Flare Grunts were trying to capture Z2. She managed to hit Z2 with a beam from her specialized gun, preventing Z2 from camouflaging itself. When she and Aliana ordered their Pokémon, and , to attack Z2, it transformed into its and used its powerful attacks to defeat Team Flare and managed to escape. She and Aliana caught up to it, only to face , who wanted Z2 for themselves. Due to Team Rocket's intervention, Z2 managed to escape once again. Team Flare, however, quickly found them and a battle between both teams took place. After a prolonged struggle, Team Flare emerged victorious and managed to corner Z2. This, however, triggered Z2 to transform to its 50% Forme and it easily blew Mable and the others back. As Z2 was about to finish them off, Alain and his interfered and battled Z2 to buy her and Aliana time. While Z2 was battling, she and Aliana surprised it by shooting it with their laser guns, finally bringing it down and captured it, completing their mission.

During Team Flare's attack on Lumiose City, Mable had been ordered to stay at Lysandre Labs. In Coming Apart at the Dreams!, she and Celosia saw a helicopter containing , Mairin, Professor Sycamore, and Team Rocket nearing Lysandre Labs through their security cameras. In the following episode, Mable tried taking down the helicopter with her Weavile, but she was attacked by and his . She and several Team Flare Grunts then faced Steven in battle, but were presumably defeated. In Rocking Kalos Defenses!, Mable joined Celosia in her battle against Team Rocket. However, the two Scientists were quickly defeated and subdued.

===Pokémon Adventures===
 
Mable debuted in X-actly What They Wanted. She, Aliana, and a group of s traveled to Vaniville Town to steal 's Mega Ring. While protecting her from the two scientists, X's Kanga was injured. This angered Kanga's baby, Li'l Kanga, who reacted to the Mega Ring and Mega Evolved into Mega Kangaskhan and easily drove the villains off.

In Inn-teresting Developments, X's friends stayed at an Aquacorde Town inn while he slept in the tent on 's 's back. The inn was a trap designed to keep Y and the others inside while Mable and Aliana tried to steal Li'l Kanga when X wasn't looking. Y broke out and informed X of the situation, but when he tried to Mega Evolve Li'l Kanga again, it failed. With no other options, X and Y teamed up with Chespin and Froakie to defeat the scientists. X had Chespin pin Mable and Aliana to a tree with , preventing them from chasing the Vaniville children as they fled to a nearby forest. 

In The Aegislash Agenda, Mable and Aliana met with Bryony and Xerosic at the Team Flare Secret HQ. They were informed that their repeat failures have led to Celosia taking over their duties.

In Gyarados Changes, Mable and the other female scientists witnessed X trying to break into the Secret HQ. Noting Celosia hadn't slept since she brought Xerneas back to base, Mable and Aliana offered to stop X in her place, only for Bryony to tell them to return to their stations. Later, after the ultimate weapon was stopped by X and his friends, Mable and Aliana helped Bryony up after she was defeated by Y and her newly caught Xerxer.

In Charizard Transforms, Mable and the other female scientists each intercepted Y and her friends to prevent them from reaching the Pokémon Village. Mable picked as her opponent. Although Mable proved to be powerful, she was defeated when Tierno's evolved into , giving it the power to take down Mable and her at the same time.

====Pokémon====
 

==Trivia==
Mable's design for Pokémon X and Y was illustrated by Rafał Gosieniecki. 
In , the visor Mable once wore during her time as one of Team Flare's scientists appears on her desk, next to her laptop.
Some aspects of Mable's redesign for Legends: Z-A reference her previous design and past. She wears a clear visor over her eyes, a reference to her old visor; a blue tie around her neck, a callback to the blue tie she wore in her original design; and a white lab coat, which while typical of Pokémon Professors, is a reference to her former occupation as one of Team Flare's scientists.
In Mable's Legends: Z-A redesign her feet are modeled despite not being visible in game normally.
